how_to_apply: Visit the official OJAS website at ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not already registered.
Open Online Application and select Apply.
Choose GSSSB from the organization list.
Select Advertisement No. 467/2026-27 for Surveyor, Class-3.
Open More Details to read the notification, then select Apply Now.
Enter the required personal details and educational qualifications.
Provide SSC examination details, category and other required information.
Enter the bank account details requested for examination fee refund and upload the first page of the passbook.
Complete the declaration and save the application.
Upload the prescribed photograph and signature.
Review the application and select Confirm Application after verifying all entries.
Save the Confirmation Number and download the confirmed application.
Pay the applicable examination fee through the OJAS payment facility by 23 November 2026.
Download and retain the fee receipt for future reference.
Important: OTR registration alone does not constitute submission of an application. Candidates must separately apply for the advertised post, confirm their application and complete payment.

After final confirmation, application details cannot be modified. Where more than one application is submitted for the same advertisement, the latest confirmed application will be considered under the notification.
important_instructions: Eligible Gujarat-origin reserved-category candidates may claim reservation and age relaxation according to the notification.

SEBC candidates must possess a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the prescribed format and validity period. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate under the accepted Gujarat or Central Government provisions. Reservation benefits are subject to certificate verification. Applicants must enter the correct category and certificate details before final confirmation. PwD candidates may apply only where the disability is compatible with the prescribed post requirements. Eligible Ex-Servicemen may claim reservation and age relaxation under the notified conditions.
Candidates should check the exact certificate validity periods and prescribed formats before applying. Incorrect category or certificate details may result in rejection during document verification.

Applications are accepted online through OJAS only. The recruitment covers 78 Surveyor Class-3 vacancies. The closing date for online applications is 20 November 2026. The fee payment deadline is 23 November 2026. Candidates must possess the prescribed qualification by the application closing date. Bachelor's degree holders in Civil Engineering are excluded under the advertised qualification conditions. Physical measurement standards apply to both male and female candidates. A walking test is required at the appointment stage. The examination consists of 210 MCQs for 210 marks. Part A and Part B each require a minimum of 40% marks. The competitive examination carries 0.25 negative marking per wrong answer. Examination fees are refundable only under the notified attendance and application-validity conditions. Any changes to the recruitment will be published on the official GSSSB website.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Surveyor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: GSSSB has announced 78 Surveyor Class-3 vacancies , including 35 Unreserved, 9 EWS, 4 SC, 10 ST and 20 SEBC posts. Of the total vacancies, 24 are reserved for women within their respective categories. Reservation Note: Women's and Ex-Servicemen vacancies are included within the total 78 posts and must not be added separately. The notification does not earmark a separate PwD vacancy, although candidates with the specifically permitted disability categories may apply subject to the prescribed conditions. Reserved-category benefits are available according to Gujarat Government rules and the candidate's eligibility as an original resident of Gujarat. The notified vacancy count may increase or decrease. content_sections.text: The Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board has issued for 78 Surveyor Class-3 vacancies under the Forest and Environment Department. content_sections.heading: GSSSB Surveyor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed Diploma in Civil Engineering or recognized equivalent qualification, or a Government-recognized ITI Surveyor course certificate . Basic computer knowledge, adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, and the specified physical standards are also required. Important: Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering are not eligible under the exclusion stated in the official recruitment rules. Applicants should not assume that having a higher Civil Engineering qualification overrides this restriction. In addition to the Civil Engineering Diploma, the Forest and Environment Department recognizes the following equivalent qualifications for Surveyor recruitment: The recognized equivalent diploma list is based on the Forest and Environment Department resolution dated 27 May 2026. Candidates with qualifications not included in the recognized list should verify their eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Surveyor Physical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: The Surveyor post requires minimum physical measurements. Candidates should check these standards carefully because they form part of the prescribed recruitment eligibility. Male candidates must have a minimum chest expansion of 5 cm. The recruitment rules require candidates selected through direct recruitment to complete a prescribed walking test at the appointment stage. Candidates unable to complete the walking test or absent from the test may receive one additional opportunity under the notified conditions. Failure to qualify or attend on the additional opportunity will result in cancellation of appointment. Important: The walking test is conducted by the appointing authority at the appointment stage after GSSSB recommendation. It should not be confused with the competitive written examination.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Surveyor, Class-3 recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) under the Forest and Environment Department for filling 78 vacancies across the state of Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced for GSSSB Surveyor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 78 vacancies have been notified for the Surveyor, Class-3 post, with specific category-wise reservation distribution available for unreserved, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What are the starting and ending dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 30 October 2026 at 14:00 hours, and candidates can submit their forms and pay fees until 20 November 2026 up to 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for GSSSB Surveyor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification, alongside a certificate of a minimum one or two years course of Surveyor from a recognized ITI. Bachelor's degree holders in Civil Engineering are not eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 33 years of age as on 20 November 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories, women, and other eligible groups as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for general and reserved categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400/- for reserved category candidates including women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, Divyang, and Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for GSSSB Surveyor, Class-3?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 26,000/- for the first five years, followed by regular pay in Level-4 ranging from Rs. 25,500/- to Rs. 81,100/- upon satisfactory service.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a single-stage MCQ competitive examination conducted via CBRT or OMR, followed by provisional results, certificate verification, merit listing, and a walking test.

faq.question: Q9. Are bachelor's degree holders in Civil Engineering eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates holding a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering are explicitly stated as not eligible to apply for the Surveyor, Class-3 position under this advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online for this examination?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can complete their One Time Registration and submit their online applications through the official OJAS website or via the direct application link provided by GSSSB.
